about: Save/resume of solo games against the AI. One set of cases for both apps: iOS ParityGoldenTests.testResumeCasesOnBothPlatforms and Android ParityGoldenTest.resumeCasesOnBothPlatforms run every case, and there are no platform-only cases. strings are the exact user-visible text; notices dismiss themselves after noticeSeconds or with the dismiss button. launch: times are seconds before launch and leftAgo null means the app died in the foreground; files lists what is on disk (sidecar, checkpoint, marker), and sidecarText replaces the sidecar's bytes. appBuild, engine or format set to a value makes the saved game differ from the running app. expect is offer, none, or the key of the one notice shown. The rule: with no sidecar, a checkpoint is deleted without a notice. A sidecar without a checkpoint, or an unreadable sidecar, is endedOnClose. Otherwise expiry is checked first: now - (leftAt ?? lastCheckpointAt) > windowSeconds is expired whatever the build, and exactly windowSeconds still resumes. Only then does a different appBuild, engine or format give updated. The in-progress marker of a game that could not checkpoint gives endedOnClose when nothing else applies. After any outcome but offer the checkpoint, the sidecar and the marker are all deleted; an offer keeps both files and deletes the marker. detail: the prompt's second line, counted from the last checkpoint and rounded down to whole minutes, or whole hours from 60 minutes. over: polls after which this seat's saved game is deleted (the game ended, or this seat lost or left and now spectates).
